messages:
marco: Heads-up  Zenith Therapeutics invoice INV-13333 failed three attempts this morning. Customer says their corporate card is being blocked for B2B vendor category. Seen 2026-06-12 13:27 UTC.
sasha: can you paste the stripe webhook snippet so we can see failure_code / outcome?
marco: pasted below:
```
evt: evt_7ZyQw
pi: pi_7ZyQwAAA
charges.data[0].failure_code: card_not_supported
failure_message: "Card cannot be used for this merchant category."
outcome.risk_level: elevated
card_brand: Amex
last4: 2468
```
marco: They emailed billing: treasury says their virtual card provider (Ramp) blocked the merchant category and asked for an alternate payment method: ACH micro-deposits or one-time wire. They also need the invoice to include PO# PO-8892 or payment will be delayed.
payments-ops: Pause automatic retries on their profile. For ACH we can send micro-deposit form, but they need to initiate from Ramp. Wire is fastest if they can get approver signoff.
billing-bot: Automatic retry schedule paused for zeniththerapeutics_com.
marco: Finance - please create a manual invoice INV-13334 for $32,100 (includes $1,200 in overage) net 3 and include PO-8892 on the invoice. GL 4420. We also need to note payer tax id and remittance email.
sasha: ok to waive late fee for this cycle given vendor category block? Approver: sasha. Log waiver reason in memo.
payments-ops: Creating INV-13334 now and emailing secure bank link to treasurer@zenithtx.com. For wire recording use internal API (ops-only):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/payments/manual"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-13334","amount_cents":3210000,"method":"wire","note":"Zenith Therapeutics wire 2026-06-12 PO-8892"}'
```
stripe-agent: Opening Stripe case stripe_case_20260612-ZEN to investigate BIN / merchant category block and see if there's remediation for future virtual-card declines.
marco: I'll request PO and confirm whether they can run micro-deposits via Ramp. If they canwe'll accept ACH and save wire as fallback.
sasha: Also confirm whether Ramp can white-list our MCC for that vendor; if so we may not need persistent changes.
marco: Call scheduled with Zenith treasury at 15:00 PT. I'll update with bank ref if they wire.
billing-bot: INV-13334 created and status: pending. Original invoice INV-13333 retry schedule suspended.
payments-ops: Reminder: when recording manual wire, include bank reference and payer legal name. We'll reconcile once funds settle.
marco: Call done. Treasury confirmed wire sent and provided bank reference ZEN-WIRE-555 (redacted). Uploaded proof to vault and added PO-8892 to invoice.
payments-ops: Bank ref ZEN-WIRE-555 received. Recording manual payment and marking INV-13334 awaiting settlement. Will mark paid when funds clear.
stripe-agent: stripe_case_20260612-ZEN opened. Following up with Stripe on MCC block and virtual card handling.
sasha: thanks team. Closing thread after settlement and stripe update. :lock: :white_check_mark:
